description: A Flutter widget named ReadingPane that displays the current chapter and its sections, including handling loading states and absence of a selected chapter. It uses context-driven state management via Provider to access BookState and displays chapter data with themed text styling.

classes.name: ReadingPane
classes.description: StatelessWidget that renders a reading interface for the current chapter, showing title and sections with styled text and handling loading states.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ReadingPane, displaying a loading indicator, a message if no chapter is selected, or the chapter content including title and sections.
